WrQNBdtGT8g.title: Can I Build This Tiny Robot From Scratch in the Middle of China?
WrQNBdtGT8g.description:
Is it possible to come up with a robot idea right before a flight and turn it into reality while touring factories in the heart of China? In this video, I attempt exactly that after being flown out by Manifold Tech to explore the incredible manufacturing hubs of Shenzhen. Let me know what you think of this challenge in the comments, and be sure to subscribe if you want to see more engineering adventures like this!

kG9CeR6zm20.description:
Join us as Executioner Remastered travels to NRL Nationals in Ohio, one of the toughest combat robotics events for the 15lb weight class, hosted by Xtreme STEM.

Executioner is a 15lb Dogeweight robot featuring a two-foot wide frame and a heavy vertical beater bar intended to destroy it's opponents. In this video you'll see behind the scenes, funny moments from our trip, and each of Executioner's intense fights.

1UDsWkcQZhc.title: How I Made This Tiny Walking Robot From Scratch
1UDsWkcQZhc.description:
This is Sesame, a little walking robot friend that's super budget friendly. It's powered by eight servo motors and uses an OLED screen on the front to make endearing faces. Sesame may be simple, but its design is pretty smart. This video details how I came up with the Sesame Robot Project, its evolution into an Open-Source project, and a short dive into the tech-stack that makes it work. I spent over four months designing and researching this robot, and I'm super excited to share it.
